label: ryzen9900x-8t-32g
why: Every number published here comes from this one configuration. Implementations are the axis under comparison, so the machine must not move: a second host would make cross-implementation gaps unreadable.
host: Proxmox VM 100 on a Ryzen 9 9900X / 64 GB DDR5-6000 homelab. Reshaped for benchmarking: 8 cores pinned via `qm set 100 --affinity 0-7`, `--cpu host` (exposes AVX-512 on Zen 5), `--memory 32768`.

tolerance.note: The guest reports slightly less RAM than provisioned; anything outside this band is a different machine and the driver refuses to label it as the reference.
